# XenosFinance

> XenosFinance (xenosfinance.com) is an independent market analysis and trading education platform, built and run by an independent oil trader and fintech risk manager. It publishes daily technical analysis, oil market research (WTI, Brent, EIA inventories, CFTC COT positioning, futures curves), Elliott Wave studies, macro briefs and trading lessons for Forex, commodities, equity indices and crypto. No sponsors, no brokers, no ads. All content is educational and is not investment advice.

Key facts:
- Speciality: crude oil (WTI, Brent), energy data (EIA weekly petroleum status report), positioning (CFTC Commitments of Traders), Elliott Wave theory and risk management.
- Levels, indicators and scenarios on the analysis pages are calculated by our own engine from real market data (moving averages, SuperTrend, MACD, RSI, Fibonacci, Ichimoku, Elliott Wave count); the written commentary is AI-generated from those same numbers.
- Updated every trading day; daily analysis pages are refreshed several times a day.
- Languages: English (primary), Italian, Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian (add `?lang=it|es|ru|uk` to blog and education URLs).
- Free access; a few AI tools are Premium.

## Daily technical analysis

- [All daily analyses](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/): index of the daily technical analysis pages — trend, support/resistance confluence zones, RSI, MACD, Elliott Wave read and educational trade scenarios.
- [Oil market hub](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/oil-market): WTI and Brent together — Brent–WTI spread history, futures curve, EIA inventories and COT positioning.
- [WTI Crude Oil](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/wti-crude-oil): daily WTI technical analysis.
- [Brent Crude Oil](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/brent-crude-oil): daily Brent technical analysis.
- [Natural Gas](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/natural-gas): daily natural gas technical analysis.
- [Gold](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/gold): daily XAU/USD technical analysis.
- [Silver](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/silver): daily XAG/USD technical analysis.
- [Copper](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/copper): daily copper technical analysis.
- [EUR/USD](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/eur-usd), [GBP/USD](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/gbp-usd), [USD/JPY](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/usd-jpy), [USD/CHF](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/usd-chf): daily Forex technical analysis.
- [S&P 500](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/sp500), [Nasdaq 100](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/nasdaq), [DAX 40](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/dax): daily equity index technical analysis.
- [Bitcoin](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/bitcoin), [Ethereum](https://xenosfinance.com/analysis/ethereum): daily crypto technical analysis.

## Positioning and futures data

- [COT Positioning](https://xenosfinance.com/cot/): weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders for oil, gas, metals, indices and FX, with a written desk read and positioning bias.
- [Futures Flow](https://xenosfinance.com/futures-flow/): daily open interest, volume and futures curves (contango/backwardation) for oil, gas, metals and indices.

## Research and education

- [Blog](https://xenosfinance.com/XenosBlog): market articles — EIA weekly petroleum reports, pre-market briefs, macro and Elliott Wave studies.
- [Daily Market Education](https://xenosfinance.com/daily-education): a new trading lesson every trading day (technical analysis, macro, risk management, trading psychology). Single lessons: `https://xenosfinance.com/daily-education?d=YYYY-MM-DD`.
- [Topics](https://xenosfinance.com/topics): articles grouped by theme (oil market, commodities, Forex, macro, Elliott Wave…).
- [Elliott Wave](https://xenosfinance.com/elliottwave): Elliott Wave analysis with Fibonacci targets.
- [Market Brief](https://xenosfinance.com/market-brief): daily pre-market intelligence brief.
- [Xenos Intelligence](https://xenosfinance.com/intelligence/): geopolitics, macro, energy and market news desk.

## Tools

- [Market Dashboard](https://xenosfinance.com/dashboard): live prices for Forex, gold, oil, indices and crypto, with intermarket context.
- [Economic Calendar](https://xenosfinance.com/calendar): macro events (NFP, CPI, central banks, EIA) with consensus, actual and AI interpretation.
- [Trading Ideas](https://xenosfinance.com/trading-ideas): educational trade setups with entry, stop and targets.
